title: Quantify Labs: opaque inference path delay & 5xx surge — exec coordination
text:
Quantify Labs: opaque inference path delay & 5xx surge — exec coordination

["From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com>\\nTo: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800\\nSubject: sudden 5xx spike + tail latency on inference calls (region us-west)\\n\\nConnor —\\n\\nWe're seeing a large spike in 5xx responses and end-to-end p95 latency for inference calls routed to the us-west cluster starting ~08:45 PT. Error rate jumped from ~0.3% to ~6% and token throughput dropped by ~40%. Our side hasn't changed traffic patterns; we sent the traces and a small pcap to this email (attached).\\n\\nCan you confirm this is on Redwood's side? Critical for our checkout flow — procurement is paused until this stabilizes.\\n\\nI've included ops@quantifylabs so they see the ticket.\\n\\nThanks,\\nSam Chen\\nHead of Platform\\nQuantify Labs\\n\\nAttachments: quantify_request_traces_20260225.zip (pcap, logs)\\n", "From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>\\nTo: Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:26:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: sudden 5xx spike + tail latency on inference calls (region us-west)\\n\\nSam —\\n\\nThanks for the traces and the heads-up. I'm starting a triage now and looping in our on-call infra (Marissa) and network lead (Neha). Early ask: can you confirm whether Quantify is using a shared VPC peer or a dedicated peering connection? That will help narrow the surface.\\n\\nI've uploaded your attachments to a private incident folder and opened JIRA-INF-4721. I will push a short status update every 30 minutes. If you can forward the exact timestamps for a failing request id, that will speed matching.\\n\\nConnor O'Brien\\nAccount Lead, Redwood Inference\\nconnor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147\\n\\nOn Wed, Feb 25, 2026 at 09:15 AM Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com> wrote:\\n> Connor —\\n> \\n> We're seeing a large spike in 5xx responses...\\n", "From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>\\nTo: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com>\\nCc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: sudden 5xx spike + tail latency on inference calls (region us-west)\\n\\nQuick summary from triage so far:\\n- Telemetry: proxy 5xx spike aligns with a surge of TCP retransmits and SYN retries hitting our regional edge between 08:42–09:05 PT. Client RTTs show sudden 150–300ms hops compared to baseline ~20–30ms.\\n- Traces: packet captures from Quantify show several mid-path RSTs and a subset of DNS responses that are returning unexpected private IPs.\\n- Hypothesis: split-horizon DNS or an upstream resolver intermittently returning internal addresses is causing the request to be forwarded into an unintended transit path where NAT/resolution mismatches produce SYN timeouts at our edge proxies.\\n\\nAction items underway:\\n1) Neha is validating VPC peering route tables and NAT metrics for us-west.\\n2) I'm collecting proxy-level logs and token-level error payloads for the window and will share a trimmed set.\\n3) Connor — recommend we brief Quantify execs with a single consolidated timeline once we confirm path/root cause.\\n\\nAttachments: redwood-internal-snapshot-logs-connor-20260225.txt (proxy excerpts)\\n\\nMarissa Cole\\nSRE, Redwood Inference\\nmarissa.cole@redwood.com\\n", "From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>\\nTo: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com>\\nCc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 12:18:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: sudden 5xx spike + tail latency on inference calls (region us-west)\\n\\nUpdate from network checks:\\n- VPC peering status: active (no BGP flap history). Route tables look unchanged.\\n- NAT gateway: connection counts spiked ~3x in the affected window; however capacity metrics did not breach configured thresholds.\\n- Upstream resolver chain: we observed intermittent NXDOMAIN->private-ip fallbacks from a third-party resolver in Quantify's transit path; engineering on the Quantify side confirmed they had a resolver maintenance window overlapping the incident.\\n\\nPreliminary conclusion: combination of transient resolver behavior + a suboptimal failover path led to requests being routed through a longer transit route (additional AS hops) and some of those paths hit intermediate firewalls/proxies that were applying connection timeouts aggressively. That produced the elevated handshake failures and 5xx churn.\\n\\nNext steps I'm running now:\\n- Pinpoint exact AS hops for the failing request ids and capture traceroutes.\\n- Recommend short-term mitigation: pin Quantify's traffic to our dedicated peering (if available) or modify routing policy to prefer direct peering for the next 24 hours.\\n\\nNeha Kapoor\\nNetwork Lead, Redwood Inference\\nneha.kapoor@redwood.com\\n", "From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>\\nTo: Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>\\nCc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 13:02:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: sudden 5xx spike + tail latency on inference calls (region us-west)\\n\\nSam —\\n\\nThanks to Marissa and Neha for the quick analysis. We have two parallel actions:\\nA) Immediate mitigation (hours):\\n- We can route Quantify traffic to the dedicated peering for us-west for the next 24 hours to avoid the transient resolver chain. That will require a short coordination window with your networking team — will you approve the switch?\\n- We'll also increase proxy handshake timeouts in the affected cluster from 3s -> 6s to reduce SYN-abort failures while we stabilize.\\n\\nB) Longer-term (days):\\n- Postmortem to validate upstream resolver SLAs and add resolver health monitoring to our edge.\\n- Add a routing policy that prefers direct peering for customers with sensitive checkout paths.\\n\\nSam — please confirm if Quantify can accept the short peering cutover. If yes, I'll schedule the cutover with your ops and our infra at 16:00 PT today. Vivek, Lauren — looping you in because this is at risk of delaying the QNT renewal (sales/procurement are watching).\\n\\nConnor\\n", "From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com>\\nTo: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>\\nCc: procurement@quantifylabs.com\\nDate: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 08:05:00 -0800\\nSubject: Re: sudden 5xx spike + tail latency on inference calls (region us-west)\\n\\nConnor / Team —\\n\\nWe will accept the dedicated peering cutover. Ops can be ready at 16:00 PT today. Please share the exact runbook and expected customer impact window. Procurement: note the cutover and that we may request a short service credit if errors persist.\\n\\nThank you for the rapid response.\\n\\nSam\\n", "From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>\\nTo: Sam Chen <sam.chen@quantifylabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>\\nCc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>\\nDate: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 17:02:00 -0800\\nSubject: RE: Quantify Labs: opaque inference path delay & 5xx surge — exec coordination\\n\\nCutover complete at 16:23 PT. Summary:\\n- Traffic pinned to dedicated peering; proxy handshake timeout increased during window.\\n- Post-cutover metrics (15m): 5xx rate back to baseline (0.28%), p95 latency returned within 5% of previous baseline, throughput recovered.\\n- We captured traceroutes and resolver logs for a 2-hour window and will upload a postmortem to JIRA-INF-4721 tomorrow.\\n\\nNext immediate asks:\\n- Vivek / Lauren: agree we present a short exec note to Quantify leadership summarizing root cause and next steps (postmortem + SLA guardrails)?\\n- Marissa / Neha: please flag any follow-ups that require product/ops changes so I can include them in the timeline.\\n\\nConnor O'Brien\\nAccount Lead, Redwood Inference\\nconnor.obrien@redwood.com\\n\\n--\\nInternal: incident folder https://drive.internal/redwood/incidents/JIRA-INF-4721 (restricted)\\n"]
